description: Overview of the connected sevDesk account and of this server's permissions. Call it first in a session to orient yourself: it returns the bookkeeping system version (1.0 or 'Update 2.0', which decides whether documents use taxRule or taxType), the VAT regulation (regular or Kleinunternehmer, which decides the tax rules) and chart of accounts, the sevDesk users (Benutzer; their ids are needed as contactPerson on invoices, orders and credit notes) and which permission tiers (read, write, commit, external), toolsets, dry-run and confirmation mode are active, so you know what you may do before you try.
name: sevdesk_account_info
title: sevDesk account overview
